Interview Experience
Name : Shrishail Gouragond
Computer Engineering
The pointer criteria for applying was 7.5+.
Round 01: Coding Round
There were only four coding questions, no multiple choice, 120 minutes. This round was
the only one that was conducted online. Platform-HackerRank. I solved 3 out of 4
questions completely and was able to solve only 4 test cases of one question.
Round 02: Technical Interview 01 (Around 45 mins)
The interviewer asked me if I would like having coffee or tea. Then the interview process
began. I was expecting the typical ‘Introduce yourself’ question but the interviewer was
pretty straightforward. Neither did he ask me about my projects nor about my internship
at UBS. He began with the OOPs section.
1. Explain the pillars of OOPS.
2. Difference between Encapsulation and abstraction.
3. Explain polymorphism.
I explained including its types to which he asked to demonstrate the run time
polymorphism using a code ( Method overriding ) .Also he added a few questions
where he wrote a code snippet and asked me to predict the output or to tell
whether the code will compile or not.

4. Then he gave me a few requirements ,asked me to design a class for that. Which
included designing a Vehicle Interface and a Car class. The car class included
attributes such as name , color. And a constructor which initializes its name.
Then he asked me about what all data structures do i know.
5. Difference between the Array and ArrayList as i mentioned Java as my preferred
language.
6. Explain the working of stack and queue with complexities and asked me different
ways of implementing stack and queue.
7. Then he asked me about the complexities of different data structures.
8. Then to my surprise he asked me a very simple DSA question, ‘Reverse an Array’.
Yes, you read it right. To which i gave him a bruteforce solution first and later gave
optimal approach. Then he asked me to write down the code on a paper.
9. After this he asked me to write a code to sort that array. He didn’t mention specific
algo, so i went with the easy one ‘Bubble sort’.
Then he told he was done with the interview and asked me if i had any questions.
To which i asked him, What all tech stack will i have to work on if i join your team.
He explained about what his team actually does and told me about the tech stack.
And the First round ended here.
Based on my discussion with my other friends who finished first round i felt that
first round was for Core subjects and DSA, most of them were not asked about
Project or internship.
They eliminated 6 students after the first round.
Round 03: Technical Interview 02 (Around 45 mins)

He started by seeing my resume, and asked If I'm a java guy. He asked me to introduce
myself.
Later he asked me about one of my projects which i mentioned during my introduction.
We had a detailed discussion regarding that project. Make sure you know everything
about your projects that you mention. Later he moved on to another project from my
resume.
Then he asked me ,
1. How was your internship at UBS ?
2. He asked me about my project that i worked on during my internship which was a
Java based project. We had a detailed discussion on it.
3. What all difficulties did you face during your internship ?
Then he began with the core subjects ,
4. What do you know about OOPS.
5. Explain the concept of encapsulation.
6. Explain about inheritance.
7. Explain the difference between method overloading and overriding.
8. Then he asked me whether we could achieve method overloading using different
classes.
9. Then he wrote a complex code which included 4 classes where there was a
concept of overriding between two classes. And there was a normal single
inheritance between the other two classes. He asked various different questions
based on this scenario.
10.
Then he began with DBMS. What is Indexing ? To which i gave a detailed in
depth explanation.
11.
What is normalization ?
12.
He asked about Views . Which again i explained in detail with a real life example
of a window.
13.
Then he asked me about the ACID properties.

Then he told he is done with the interview and asked me if i had any questions. I
asked him about his experience working in BNY.
After this round, almost all the students were called for the HR round.
My HR interview was scheduled at 6.15 pm.
Round 04: HR Round (Around 30 mins)
The HR greeted me and asked me to take a seat. He firstly saw my Feedback report that
was forwarded by the previous interviewers which also included the coding round
results.
He asked me about the coding round. And then asked about how was my Day so far and
how was the interview process.
Then he proceeded with the HR round questions :
1. Introduce yourself.
2. Where do you see yourself after 5 years ?
3. What are your strengths and weaknesses ?
4. He asked me regarding the UBS internship. And he asked me if I had received the
PPO offer from UBS. TO which I replied YES. Then he asked me why BNY ?
5. After answering he asked me, How will you manage your work and learning ?
Then he said he was done with the interview, and asked me if I had any questions for
him.
To which I asked him several questions. They mentioned different streams of which they
manage the money. I asked about the flow. Then I asked him if there are any
commitments like a fixed amount of returns to be given to the clients. Then I asked him
what if the clients cheat on the company.

Then I asked him how his day at BNY Mellon was like. To which he told his daily
schedule. Then I asked him how he manages both work and personal life.
Then I thanked him for the opportunity. And the interview ended.
This was the four round process. Most of the students who were shortlisted for the
second technical interview got a mail for the HR interview.
The Hr interviews lasted till 9 pm . We were informed about the results being announced
on the same day, so all of us were waiting in the TPO hall till the end. Around 9.55 pm
the BNY team came into the hall and announced the results.
12 students were selected and I was one of them.
There were celebrations and everyone in the hall was happy. The team congratulated all
the participants and to end, all of us had a group photo.
And the day ended…!!
